body.heading: Where in the world is Solomon Islands?
paragraphs: Solomon Islands is a country in Melanesia, which is part of Oceania. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Solomon Islands is Honiara.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Solomon Islands is English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Solomon Islands is the Solomon Islands dollar.

body.heading: How big is Solomon Islands?
paragraphs: Solomon Islands covers about 29,000 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Guadalcanal's battlefields, memorials and the sunken ships at Bonegi Beach tell the story of 1942 — history you can walk and snorkel.
Marovo is the world's largest saltwater lagoon, a maze of reef islands famous for master woodcarvers, diving and village stays.
